# Asset provenance report (Sprint 16)
**What this is.** The rights position of every AI-generated raster in the NASHA manifest, regenerated by `python3 tools/provenance_report.py`. **Known:** all integrated rasters are PROVISIONAL-LOCAL-ONLY and the website stays `noindex`. **Unresolved:** provider terms from primary sources, attorney review, replacement before any public use. Nothing here is a copyright or commercial-use clearance.

## The hero image question (NV-HERO-01 / HERO-NIGHT.webp)
- **Source:** founder-supplied generation ARC-02-A (2026-10-10), later cropped and overlaid with a scripted NASHA wordmark (2026-10-11; temporary typographic placeholder under D-66, "CONCEPT, NOT OFFICIAL").
- **Which generator?** The manifest rows for the crops record "OpenAI image generation (per founder; model not recorded)"; `visuals/generated/LOG.md` records ARC-02-A as "External image generator (tool/model not stated)"; the NV-HERO-01 row records an unspecified external generator. These do not fully agree, so **provenance is UNCERTAIN, not confirmed OpenAI**. The images are NOT from Figma (the 10 Figma candidates are not integrated).
- **Terms evidence:** OpenAI's output terms are known only from secondary quotes (ledger V-71, T1): output rights assigned to the user subject to compliance, contractual not a copyright guarantee, similar output may go to others. Model, plan and terms version at the creation date are unknown. `docs/ai/PROVIDER-TERMS-MATRIX.csv` marks every OpenAI cell UNVERIFIED.
- **Other issues:** the uncropped source shows 8 tanks (a G-6 hard fail; the site crop shows one partial tank); no attorney review; no human authorship beyond crop and placeholder overlay (US Copyright Office view that prompts alone give limited authorship, V-69).
- **Decision:** do not delete (it is the current concept hero); keep PROVISIONAL-LOCAL-ONLY; **replace before any public launch** with a purpose-built or real image (manifest replacement plans NV-PLAN-*); founder to confirm which tool made ARC-02-A if known.

## Other assets reviewed this sprint
Glass studies and renders (`visuals/glass-studies/`): generated locally by project scripts (OpenSCAD/Blender), no third-party model, no marks; project-owned concept geometry, MANUFACTURABILITY UNVERIFIED. Yelp dataset (`ops/data/`): third-party listings, internal only, terms UNVERIFIED, Yelp photos not used. Literature entries record citations and abstracts only. Vendored BeerJSON schema: MIT, attribution in `tools/vendor/beerjson/SOURCE.txt`.
